caption: The drawing depicts six rectangular woven samples arranged in three rows and two columns on a plain, off-white background. All rectangles are composed of horizontal stripes in shades of red, blue, and a lighter beige or off-white color. The top-left sample has alternating thin blue, thin beige, and medium red stripes. The top-right sample features thicker horizontal stripes of blue, red, and thinner beige accents. The middle-left sample consists mainly of a red background with thinner blue and beige horizontal strips distributed evenly. The middle-right sample shows a pattern with bands of blue interspersed with small beige rectangles and bordered by red. The bottom-left sample is made up of three broad horizontal bands—red at the top, dark blue in the center, and red again at the bottom—with a thinner, lighter blue stripe at the bottom edge. The bottom-right sample presents alternating medium-width horizontal stripes of blue, red, and dark blue, with the blue stripes occupying the top and bottom areas. The objects all have clean edges, uniform widths, and consistent woven textures. The name "CONNIE A. GARNER" is faintly inscribed near the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Fragments of Shaker Chair Braid
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
